nodes.description: Public mapping (address => uint256) holding token balances of every account.
Public string token name 'CAC_2400_20200917'.
Public string token symbol 'CACAVT'.
Public uint8 decimals set to 18.
Public uint256 total supply minted to the deployer.
Public nested mapping (owner => spender => uint256) of spending allowances.
Constructor that assigns the whole totalSupply to the deployer balanceOf[msg.sender] and emits Transfer.
Public transfer(address to, uint256 value): checks sender balance then deducts and credits without SafeMath, returns true.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 value): writes allowance[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
Public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value): checks balance and allowance, mutates balances and allowance, emits Transfer.
Caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance owner key in every state-mutating path.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value in transfer: unchecked subtraction, underflow risk.
balanceOf[to] += value in transfer: unchecked addition to an arbitrary recipient.
allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value in approve: caller-controlled allowance write.
balanceOf[from] -= value in transferFrom: unchecked subtraction on an arbitrary owner.
balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom: unchecked addition to an arbitrary recipient.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value in transferFrom: unchecked allowance subtraction.
balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply in the constructor: initial minting of the full supply.
Parameter 'to' of transfer(), destination of the credited balance.
Parameter 'value' of transfer(), amount deducted and credited.
Parameter 'spender' of approve(), key of the written allowance.
Parameter 'value' of approve(), allowance amount granted.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(), owner whose balance and allowance are debited.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(), destination of the credited balance.
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom(), amount moved and allowance consumed.
Return variable 'success' returned as true by transfer().
Return variable 'success' returned as true by approve().
Return variable 'success' returned as true by transferFrom().

edges.reason: The constructor executes the initial balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply minting operation.
msg.sender determines which account receives the entire totalSupply at deployment.
totalSupply is the value assigned into balanceOf[msg.sender].
The constructor write stores state into the balanceOf mapping.
transfer() executes the unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value deduction.
transfer() executes the unchecked balanceOf[to] += value credit.
msg.sender indexes the balance that is decremented in transfer().
The value parameter is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
The to parameter is used as the recipient key of balanceOf[to] += value.
The value parameter is added into balanceOf[to] without SafeMath.
The subtraction updates the balanceOf state variable.
The addition updates the balanceOf state variable.
approve() executes the allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value write.
msg.sender is the owner key whose allowance is set in approve().
The caller-supplied spender parameter becomes the spender key of the allowance.
The value parameter is stored as the granted allowance amount.
The approve write updates the allowance state variable.
transferFrom() executes the unchecked balanceOf[from] -= value debit.
transferFrom() executes the unchecked balanceOf[to] += value credit.
transferFrom() executes the unchecked allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value decrement.
The from parameter indexes the balance that is debited without SafeMath.
The value parameter is subtracted from balanceOf[from] without SafeMath.
The to parameter is the recipient key of balanceOf[to] += value.
The value parameter is added into balanceOf[to] without SafeMath.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance[from][msg.sender] is consumed, gated only by require.
The value parameter is subtracted from the stored allowance without SafeMath.
The from parameter selects the owner row of the allowance that msg.sender spends.
The debit updates the balanceOf state variable.
The credit updates the balanceOf state variable.
The decrement updates the allowance state variable.
transfer() returns the boolean success local after mutating balances.
approve() returns the boolean success local after writing the allowance.
transferFrom() returns the boolean success local after mutating balances and allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter only feeds the recipient key of balanceOf inside transfer() and has no standalone semantics.
The 'value' parameter is the operand of the unchecked balance/credit arithmetic in transfer().
The 'spender' parameter is only used as the spender key in the approve allowance write.
The 'value' parameter is only used as the allowance amount written by approve().
The 'from' parameter only indexes the debited balance and consumed allowance in transferFrom().
The 'to' parameter only supplies the recipient key of the credit in transferFrom().
The 'value' parameter is the shared operand of the unchecked debits performed by transferFrom().
The success flag is a trivial constant-true return value of transfer() and carries no independent dataflow.
The success flag is a trivial constant-true return value of approve() and carries no independent dataflow.
The success flag is a trivial constant-true return value of transferFrom() and carries no independent dataflow.
